_doc:
CITY OF MATLOSANA (Klerksdorp, North West) - acct [number removed],
Telkom site KERK (NT 9) / KLERKSDORP.  11 PDFs = 11 consecutive months
Jul 2025 - Jul 2026 (Dec 2025 and May 2026 are not in the pack).

NUMBER FORMAT - NO COMMA-DECIMAL TRAP HERE.  Unlike its sibling
Ditsobotla shape B, Matlosana prints PERIOD decimals:
  shape A (10 files) SPACE thousands + period decimal   '277 810.86'
  shape B (1 file)   COMMA thousands + period decimal   '296,105.12'
                     and some values with no separator  '483178.27'
_to_decimal() deletes spaces and commas, so BOTH forms parse EXACTLY.
Every Rand figure in this profile is cent-exact; there is no rand-part
workaround and no cent-exact variant is needed.  The money token used
throughout is  (?<![\d.])(-?(?:\d{1,3}(?:[ ,]?\d{3})*)?\.\d{2})(?![\d])
- optional separator (space OR comma OR none) and an optional integer
part so a bare ',00'-style '.00' still reads 0.00.

THE AMOUNT COLUMN IS EX VAT.  Columns are DESCRIPTION / VAT / AMOUNT and
VAT is exactly 15% of AMOUNT on every taxable line (Property Rates is
zero-rated).  So NO 'sub' computes are needed - the opposite of
Ditsobotla, whose Amount column is VAT-INCLUSIVE.  Verified on all 11
bills: Sum(AMOUNT column) == printed 'Total Current Levies' and
Sum(VAT column) == printed 'VAT / BTW'.

TWO RENDER SHAPES, one template.
 SHAPE A - the 10 'COM_...' files, 1 page, ~8 300 chars.  Header is a
   packed multi-column block: 'CITY OF MATLOSANAP.O. Box 99, KLERKSDORP,
   2570' (glued), 'VAT Reg No/BTW Reg Nr  4680101146' (that is TELKOM's
   VAT number - it is on 136 bills in the pack, NEVER fingerprint on it),
   'VAT Registration Nr. / BTW Registrasie No.' with the MUNICIPALITY's
   number 4560106603 on the NEXT line, 'Acc No / Rek Nr / Lenaane',
   'Leina la Mmila  KERK (NT 9)', 'Township / Dorpsgebied / ... KLERKSDORP',
   'Ward / Afdeling / Karolo  19', 'Acc Date / Rek Datum /  JUL 2025',
   'Stand No / Erf Nr / No Ya Tulo  [number removed]', 'Deposit / Deposito :
   58140.00', 'Group Code  38', 'Market Value / Mark Waarde  [number removed]'.
 SHAPE B - the single 'MOH_[number removed]_[number removed]_102025.pdf', 227 KB
   instead of 275 KB, a DIFFERENT PDF producer.  Same template, badly
   re-flowed: labels split across lines, the street/market-value/township
   values lost, meter readings printed in SCIENTIFIC NOTATION
   ('2.[number removed]E7' = [number removed] - Decimal() parses this correctly, verified),
   the kVA row grows an extra 'prev reading' column, 'Total Current
   Levies / Totaal Heffings:' prints the VAT TOTAL rather than the levies,
   the ageing row is garbled, and 'TOTAL / TOTAAL / GOTLHE' and
   'Due / Verskuldig' both print 0.00.  See 'THE MOH FILE' below.

METER READINGS TABLE - YES, there is one (unlike Ditsobotla shape A):
  'Meter Type / Tipe  Meter No / Nr  Date / Datum  Current Reading /
   Huidige Lesing  Prev Reading / Vorige Lesing  Factor / Faktor
   Consumption / Verbruik'
  EL   [number removed]     [number removed]  [number removed]  [number removed]  1.00  90978   <- kWh
  EL   KVA[number removed]   [number removed]       145            1.00    145   <- kVA
  WA   351          [number removed]                      1.00     31   <- water
The kVA and water rows print NO previous reading in shape A (and a 0.0
one in shape B), which is why those two rules carry a 'patterns' pair
with the same capture groups in the same order.  current - prev ==
printed Consumption on 11/11 bills (carried as mat_reading_kwh /
mat_kwh_delta).

WHAT THE BILL DOES NOT PRINT (mapped '_none', not misses):
  tariff name, reading type (Actual/Estimated), a reading PERIOD (only
  ONE reading date per meter, so read_start is '_none' and read_end is
  that date), TOU bands (peak/off-peak), NMD, cash, guarantee, security
  held.  AND - importantly - any separate DEMAND charge: Matlosana
  prints ONE combined 'ELECTRICITY / ELEKTRISITEIT' amount covering both
  the kWh register and the kVA register, with no rate and no split.  I
  tried to solve for an energy rate + a demand rate across the 11 bills
  and there is no consistent fit (the charge amounts do not track the
  same month's readings - three consecutive bills print an identical
  108 743 kWh and identical R320 642.84, then Aug 2025 charges
  R352 135.60 for 86 824 kWh), so the split is NOT recoverable.  Single-
  band convention: standard_kwh = total_kwh, standard_r = the whole
  ELECTRICITY amount, demand_r = '_none', demand_kva = the printed kVA
  register.  other_r = BASIC ELECTRICITY.

SECTIONS.  The bill has NO service sub-headings - it is a flat 8-line
levy list whose ORDER differs between the two shapes.  So electricity is
the only boundary-forming section (start = the readings-table banner
'WATER / ELECTRICITY CONSUMPTION', which sits above both the meter table
and the levy list, so it runs to the end of the document and 'header' is
exactly the page-1 meta block).  water/sewerage/refuse/rates/sundry are
all "overlay": true with "end": "\\Z" so they span to the end and cut
nothing; every rule then anchors on its own description text, which is
unique per service, so nothing can leak across services.

RULE ZERO.  The bill prints no ex-VAT ELECTRICITY subtotal, so
total_ex_vat_r (mat_elec_total_ex_r) is the SUM OF ITS OWN PARTS and the
engine's reconcile is CIRCULAR here - it cannot fail.  Four genuinely
independent identities are checked instead and three of them are carried
in the data so a regression shows them:
 (1) Sum(AMOUNT column, all 8 levy lines) == printed 'Total Current
     Levies'  -> mat_levy_col_sum_r vs mat_total_levies_r (10/10 exact
     on shape A; shape B mis-prints the label, see below).
 (2) Current reading - Prev reading == printed Consumption
     -> mat_kwh_delta == 0 on 11/11.
 (3) Sum(VAT column) == printed 'VAT / BTW'
     -> mat_vat_delta_r == 0.00 on 11/11.
 (4) BBF - payments + levies == printed 'TOTAL ... EXCL VAT'
     -> mat_excl_delta_r == 0.00 on 11/11.

ZERO-RATED LINE.  On shape A the PROPERTY RATES line prints NO VAT
column value at all (rates are zero-rated), so mat_rates_vat_r is a
legitimate blank on 10 of 11 bills; shape B prints an explicit 0.00.
That is why the amount and the VAT of every levy line are TWO SEPARATE
single-group rules rather than one two-group rule - a one-rule version
would have dropped the rates AMOUNT on 10 bills.

THE MOH FILE - VERDICT.  'MOH_[number removed]_[number removed]_102025.pdf' (MOH =
Mohokare) is a CITY OF MATLOSANA bill that is MISNAMED.  It carries the
'CITY OF MATLOSANA' masthead, 'P.O. Box 99, KLERKSDORP, 2570', VAT
registration 4560106603, www.matlosana.gov.za, account [number removed],
invoice [number removed]/202510, 'Acc Date ... Oct 2025', stand [number removed],
meters [number removed] / KVA[number removed] / 351 - and no Mohokare, Zastron, Rouxville
or Smithfield marker anywhere.  It is the OCTOBER 2025 bill, the one
month otherwise missing between the Sep 2025 and Nov 2025 COM files, and
its readings chain exactly into them: Sep ends 23 242 413, MOH runs
23 242 412 -> 23 339 654, Nov starts 23 339 654.  Its printed TOTAL of
0.00 is a render bug, not a zero bill: BBF 483 178.27 - payments
483 171.04 + levies 423 780.63 + VAT 57 943.27 = 481 731.13, which is
exactly the 'BALANCE BROUGHT FORWARD' printed on the November 2025 bill.
The fingerprint was NOT widened for it.

FINGERPRINT.  Anchored on the municipality's own VAT registration
4560106603 (11/487 files in the pack, all Matlosana), the masthead
'CITY OF MATLOSANA', the portal, and the bank-account name.  NOT on
'TAX INVOICE / BELASTINGFAKTUUR' (41 files - shared with Ditsobotla and
Sol Plaatjie), NOT on 'O tshwanetse go duela' (20 files - shared with
Rustenburg; this is the sentence whose 'tshwaneTSE' substring used to
hijack these bills into the 'cot' profile), NOT on 'Elektrisiteit'
(46 files), and NOT on Telkom's VAT number 4680101146 (136 files).

patterns: Stand No / Erf Nr / No Ya Tulo[ \t]{2,}(\d{5,})(?![\d])

fields.label: Total Current Levies + Total Current VAT (printed pair)
Sum of the AMOUNT/BEDRAG column (all services)
fields.pattern: ^[ \t]*(?:ELECTRICITY[ \t]*/[ \t]*ELEKTRISITEIT|BASIC ELECTRICITY|BASIC REFUSE|FIXED ADDITIONAL SEWERAGE|FIXED BASIC SEWERAGE|WATER[ \t]*-[ \t]*INTERIM|BASIC WATER|PROPERTY RATES)[^\n]*?[ \t]{2,}(?<![\d.])(-?(?:\d{1,3}(?:[ ,]?\d{3})*)?\.\d{2})(?![\d])[ \t]*$

fields.label: Sum of the VAT/BTW column (all services)
fields.pattern: ^[ \t]*(?:ELECTRICITY[ \t]*/[ \t]*ELEKTRISITEIT|BASIC ELECTRICITY|BASIC REFUSE|FIXED ADDITIONAL SEWERAGE|FIXED BASIC SEWERAGE|WATER[ \t]*-[ \t]*INTERIM|BASIC WATER|PROPERTY RATES)[^\n]*?[ \t]{2,}(?<![\d.])(-?(?:\d{1,3}(?:[ ,]?\d{3})*)?\.\d{2})(?![\d])[ \t]{2,}(?<![\d.])-?(?:\d{1,3}(?:[ ,]?\d{3})*)?\.\d{2}(?![\d])[ \t]*$
